# netcup_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key in the netcup SCP account (used for server image setup).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_ssh_key" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy-key"
  key  = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA... user@host"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) SSH public key, e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA...`.
- `name` (String) Key name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) SCP key id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: the SCP key id
terraform import netcup_ssh_key.deploy 42
```
